title: Vietnamese Lemongrass Chicken Noodle Bowls (Bun Ga Nuong)
hook: 4 lunches, 35 minutes: Vietnamese lemongrass chicken noodle bowls that beat takeout
benefit: Lean protein with a pile of crunchy vegetables and fresh herbs, and very little oil
ingredients: 2 stalks lemongrass, tender inner core finely minced (about 3 tbsp), or 2 tbsp lemongrass paste
4 cups shredded romaine or butter lettuce
1 cup fresh mint and cilantro leaves (Thai basil too, if you can find it)
key_ingredients: 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp brown sugar
Dressing: 3 tbsp fish sauce, 2 limes, 1 tbsp sugar
Cucumber, carrots, lettuce, sprouts, herbs, peanuts
steps: Stir the lemongrass, garlic, 2 tbsp fish sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, oil and pepper. Coat the chicken and marinate 15 minutes (or overnight in the fridge).
Boil the vermicelli 3 to 4 minutes (or soak 5 minutes in just-boiled water), drain, rinse cold and drain well.
Whisk 3 tbsp fish sauce, the lime juice, warm water, sugar, garlic and chili until the sugar dissolves.
Cook the chicken in a hot skillet or grill pan over medium-high, 5 to 6 minutes per side, until charred and 165F inside. Rest 5 minutes and slice.
Layer 4 bowls: lettuce, noodles, cucumber, carrots and sprouts, then chicken, herbs and peanuts.
Add 3 tbsp dressing and a squeeze of lime right before eating. For meal prep, pack the herbs and dressing on the side; keeps 4 days in the fridge.
vo_steps: Marinate the chicken in lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, soy and brown sugar for fifteen minutes.
Boil the rice noodles three to four minutes and rinse them cold.
Whisk fish sauce, lime, water, sugar, garlic and chili for the dressing.
Sear the chicken five to six minutes a side until charred, then slice.
Layer lettuce, noodles, cucumber, carrots, sprouts, chicken, herbs and peanuts.
Dressing on right before eating. Four lunches, done.
